scope: R2-derived explicit output-character constraint for extractive summary candidates; not full B08 acceptance

baseline.branch: work (same content as origin/main at start)

requirement_basis.r2_observable: Twelve previously unseen writing tasks satisfy length, content, purpose and format
requirement_basis.applied_slice: Enforce a supplied maximum over complete extracted sentence text. This does not establish content, purpose, semantic coverage or format acceptance.

implementation.request_contract: Strict JSON fields are text and max_sentences plus optional max_chars. max_chars is 1..100000 Unicode scalars; absent means 100000.
implementation.selection: Rank with the versioned extractive algorithm. In rank order, keep full sentences that fit the remaining character budget until max_sentences is reached; skip and record a too-long sentence, then continue to lower-ranked candidates. Restore selected candidates to source order for output.
implementation.budget_unit: Sum of Unicode scalar values in copied sentence text; fixed disclosure label, bullet markers and separators are excluded.
implementation.no_fit_behavior: SUSPEND with TEXT_SUMMARY_CHAR_LIMIT and no artifact; no sentence is truncated.
implementation.known_gap: Length compliance is a structural check only. The ranking does not prove user purpose, semantic completeness, factual correctness, conditions, negation, audience, style or overall writing quality.
